scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:portal
scripts.build:web: node --test tests/review-accounts.test.mjs tests/release-health.test.mjs tests/live-policy-library.test.mjs tests/donation-provider.test.mjs tests/issue-card-navigation.test.mjs tests/stripe-campaign.test.mjs tests/stripe-web-checkout.test.mjs tests/stripe-real-sandbox-acceptance.test.mjs tests/stripe-webhook-diagnostics.test.mjs tests/stripe-webhook.test.mjs tests/stripe-outage-routing.test.mjs tests/donation-rotation.test.mjs tests/donation-route-http.test.mjs && astro build --root apps/web && node scripts/build-indexing.mjs
scripts.build:portal: node --test tests/release-health.test.mjs tests/treasurer-admin.test.mjs && vite build --config apps/portal/vite.config.ts
scripts.test:browser: node tests/browser/journeys.mjs && node tests/browser/campaign-editor.mjs && node tests/browser/campaign-public.mjs
scripts.lint: eslint apps packages scripts tests registry
scripts.format:check: prettier --check eslint.config.mjs scripts/scan-secrets.mjs tests/secret-scanner.test.mjs tests/public-interactions.test.mjs scripts/verify.mjs tests/verify-preflight.test.mjs
